dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: It's the perfect place to make a home.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I'd love to bring Tonia, Anthon, and Teucer to stay here...

choices.text: I don't think this place can accommodate so many people...

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: Hahaha, sorry, I didn't mean it like that.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: I just think that Tonia and the others would be very happy in your company.

choices.text: I'm not actually as good with kids as you think...
